definition: Query shows coherent match to one Howell canonical architecture with supportive sequence/order/adjacency and no strong competitor
user_facing_interpretation: Genomic capsule architecture is consistent with the named Howell serovar-associated reference architecture
limitations: Not a validated phenotypic serovar call; does not override serology

definition: Architecture/target evidence supports the shared Howell 5/12 special-case architecture
user_facing_interpretation: Genomic capsule architecture is consistent with serovar 5 or 12 (not distinguished)
limitations: Cannot separate 5 from 12 with current Howell architecture evidence

definition: Two or more Howell architectures have similar support and evidence does not justify a single association
user_facing_interpretation: More than one serovar-associated architecture remains plausible
limitations: May include biologically real shared modules (e.g. 8/10)

definition: Sufficient sequence exists to interpret the locus, but architecture shows substantial non-reference gene loss/gain, mixed modules, or recurrent alternative pattern that is not assembly-explained
user_facing_interpretation: Capsule locus observed but does not fit a single canonical Howell architecture cleanly

definition: Capsule-associated evidence is too incomplete to support architecture interpretation
user_facing_interpretation: Not enough capsule-locus sequence to interpret architecture
limitations: Re-assembly or better sequencing may resolve

definition: Apparent absences or locus splits are best explained by contig fragmentation / contig-edge effects
limitations: Not proof of biological gene absence

definition: Internal genomic evidence streams conflict (e.g. diagnostic region vs multi-gene architecture) without a conservative single interpretation
user_facing_interpretation: Genomic capsule evidence is internally conflicting
limitations: Distinct from historical label conflict metadata

definition: Species confirmed but no recognizable Howell capsule architecture recovered
user_facing_interpretation: No recognized Howell capsule architecture detected
limitations: Could be true absence, extreme divergence, or technical failure

definition: DEPRECATED_AS_PRIMARY_STATE — fold into ATYPICAL_CAPSULE_PROFILE or AMBIGUOUS_ARCHITECTURE
